title: Easy Dessert Recipes
excerpt: Find easy dessert recipes for weeknights and Sunday supper—no-bake sweets, cookies, pies, cakes, brownies, and cheesecakes, all gathered in one cozy guide.
featuredImageAlt: Easy dessert recipes featuring chocolate cake, cookies, pie, and no-bake sweets
contentHtml:
A homemade dessert does not have to be complicated to feel special. Cookies cooling on the counter, a no-bake pie chilling in the fridge, or a warm dump cake from the oven can all make the table feel complete. This guide gathers Grandma Recipe’s best dessert recipes—no-bake sweets, cookies, pies, cakes, brownies, and layered dessert bars—so you can pick a path and bake with confidence.

Use this page as your starting point. Each section below links to tested recipes with clear steps, pantry-friendly ingredients, and that cozy, from-scratch sweetness we love after family supper.

How to Use This Dessert Recipes Guide

  • No oven time? Start with no-bake Oreo desserts, cheesecake cups, or banana pudding.
  • Want something shareable? Cookies, brownies, and dump cakes travel well to potlucks.
  • Need a classic finale? Pie, layer cake, or strawberry shortcake makes Sunday feel complete.
  • Craving chocolate? Jump to cakes, brownies, chocolate lasagna, and crinkle cookies.

No-Bake Desserts

No-bake desserts are weeknight heroes—cool, creamy, and ready without heating the whole kitchen.

  • No Bake Oreo Cream Pie — creamy Oreo pie with a crumb crust.
  • No Bake Oreo Dessert — layered no-bake Oreo dessert.
  • No Bake Oreo Cheesecake and No Bake Cheesecake Cup — cheesecake flavor with less fuss.
  • Oreo Lasagna and Chocolate Lasagna — layered dessert “lasagna” for a crowd.
  • Walking Banana Pudding and Not Yo Mama's Banana Pudding — banana pudding comfort in fun and classic forms.

Cookies and Bars

Cookies are the friendliest dessert recipes—mix, scoop, and bake until the kitchen smells like home.

  • Thin Chocolate Chip Cookies — thin, crisp chocolate chip cookies.
  • Chocolate Crinkle Cookies — soft chocolate crinkle cookies under powdered sugar.
  • Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies — chocolate peanut butter cookie comfort.
  • Almond Joy Cookies — coconut, chocolate, and almond cookie treats.
  • Chocolate Brownies and 3-Ingredient Brownies — fudgy brownies, including a simple three-ingredient batch.

Pies and Hand Pies

Pie is Sunday dessert at its best—flaky edges, sweet filling, and a slice that makes people linger.

  • Pecan Pie — classic pecan pie.
  • Lemon Meringue Pie — bright lemon meringue pie.
  • Buttermilk Pie — southern buttermilk pie.
  • Peanut Butter Cup Pie — peanut butter cup pie for chocolate lovers.
  • Apple Hand Pies — apple hand pies for portable pie night.

Cakes and Dump Cakes

From tall layer cakes to easy dump cakes, these dessert recipes cover celebration and weeknight sweetness alike.

  • Dark Chocolate Cake and Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake — rich chocolate cakes.
  • Strawberry Shortcake Cake and Heaven on Earth Cake — soft, creamy cake desserts.
  • Pumpkin Poke Cake, Caramel Apple Dump Cake, and Pumpkin Dump Cake — poke cakes and dump cakes with little fuss.
  • Chocolate Chip Banana Bread — chocolate chip banana bread for snack-time sweetness.

Cheesecakes

  • Turtle Cheesecake — turtle cheesecake with caramel and pecans.
  • Samoa Cheesecake — samoa-inspired cheesecake.
  • No Bake Oreo Cheesecake and No Bake Cheesecake Cup — Oreo and cup-style cheesecake treats.

Final Thoughts

Good dessert recipes do not need bakery gear—just a clear method and a little sweetness to share. Bookmark this guide, pick a cluster, and bake one recipe at a time.
